resource.name: 01 EU EPI Bundle
resource.description: This profile represents the constraints applied to the Bundle resource used in ePI, as defined by the EU ePI Common Standard. ePI is composed of multiple documents (summary of product characteristics, package leaflet, etc.). Each document is represented by a Bundle with type=document.

resource.name: 02 EU EPI Composition (General)
resource.description: This profile represents the constraints applied to the Composition resource used in ePI, as defined by the EU ePI Common Standard. The Composition captures the section headings, sub-section headings, and narrative text (For example, paragraphs, bulleted lists, tables) in an ePI document.
